weakest_scene.root_cause: The renderer reuses one bar-race template for every indicator and passes population values through unformatted, so a 2.4-billion count is drawn as a 10-digit run-on while the leader kicker stays hard-wired to '1972 PULLS AHEAD'.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Give seg2 its own demonstration: abbreviate the values (2.42B -> 3.46B) with thousands separators, drive the kicker off the actual leading row, and stage the mascot doing a rural-vs-urban bit (e.g. pushing/holding the growing bar) instead of the reused lean.
